items: Indus Valley Civilization ([[Harappan Civilization]]) existed.
Aryans came to India.
Emergence of 16 Mahajanapadas
Birth of Mahavira, the founder of [[Jainism]], in Kundagrama, Bihar
[Birth of Gautam Buddha](((dW2OI3pN6))), the founder of [[Buddhism]], in Lumbini, Kapilavastu (present day Nepal).
Death of Gautam Buddha at Kushinagar, Uttar Pradesh and the [first buddhist council](((1EzmrZJZh))) convened by Ajatashatru.
The [second buddhist council](((bcbm6Yowq))) convened by Kalasoka at Vaishali.
[[Invasion of Alexander]] of the subcontinent and the battle of Hydaspes
Chandragupta Maurya founded the [[Maurya Empire]] in Magadh region.
[Ashoka](((Qx6J43Itb))) became ruler of [[Maurya Empire]].
[Battle of Kalinga](((tUidxDj8O))) took place by Ashoka
The [third buddhist council](((fmmC9-AmB))) was convened by Ashoka at Pataliputra.
The [fourth buddhist council](((Zjzo-Auh-))) convened by Kanishka of [[Kushana dynasty]]
Saka era began.
[[Gupta dynasty]] started by Sai Gupta (Golden Age of India).
Chandragupta II (Vikramaditya) became king.
Harshavardhana ruled ( 606-647).
[Muhammad bin Qasim](((vhAtmDLHy))) invaded Sindh (first Arab attack).
Mahmud of Ghazni attacked India, in total 17 times, and looted Somnath Temple.
Battle of Peshawar, where Mahmud of Gahazni defeated Jayapala, ruler of Hindu Kush Dynasty.
Battle of Waihind, where Mahmud of Gahzni defeated Anandapapa, ruler of Hindu Kush Dynasty.
Mahmud of Ghazni invaded Solanki dynasty and plundered Somnath temple.
[Battle of Terrain-I](((4cowohnON))), where Prithviraj Chauhan defeated Muhammad Ghori
[Battle of Terrain-II](((UAWXUrVgx))), where Prithviraj Chauhan was defeated by Mohammad Ghori and Delhi came under Muslims.
Battle of Chandewar, where Mohammad Ghori defeated Jayachandra of the Gahadavala dynasty and captured Kannuj
Establishment of [[Delhi Sultanate]] by [Qutbuddin Aibak](((mSqc7xBhZ)))
Alauddin Khilji ruled (famous for market reforms).
Founded **Sangama dynasty** (Vijayanagara empire) by Harihara Raya and Bukka raya
Timur's invasion of Delhi; weakened Sultanate
Founded Saluva dynasty of VIjayanagara empire by Saluva Narasimha
Vasco da Gama reaches Calicut; Portuguese arrival in India
Founded Tuluva (of Vijayanagara empire) dynasty by Vira Narasimha
Krishnadeva Raya accession to thrown (1509-30)
Battle of Goa in which Portuguese defeated Bijapur ruler and captured Goa.
Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi in the First Battle of Panipat and founded the Mughal Empire in India.
Battle of Khanwa (Babur defeated Rana Sanga).
Babur defeated Rana Sanga of Mewar in the Battle of Khanwa and strengthened Mughal rule in north India.
Babur defeated Medini Rai in the Battle of Chanderi and captured the fort to control Malwa region.
Babur defeated the Afghans and Bengal forces in the Battle of Ghaghra and secured eastern territories.
Humayun was defeated by Sher Shah Suri in the Battle of Chausa and lost control of Bihar region.
Humayun was again defeated by Sher Shah Suri in the Battle of Kannauj and fled from India, ending early Mughal rule temporarily.
Founded Aravidu dynasty, in vijayanagara empire, by Tirumala
Second Battle of Panipat (Akbar defeated Hemu).
The Battle of Talikota (or Rakshasi-Tangadi) in 1565, where a united alliance of Deccan Sultanates (Bijapur, Golconda, Ahmadnagar, Bidar) defeated the Vijayanagara Empire
British East India Company established on 31 December 1600
Aurangzeb became Mughal emperor.
Death of Aurangzeb; decline of Mughal Empire
Battle of Plassey took place in which British (Robert Clive) defeated Siraj-ud-Daulah (British became strong in Bengal).
Hyder Ali became the defecto ruler of Mysore
Battle of Buxar in which British defeated combined forces of Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula, Shah Alam II.
Treaty of Allahabad
Mysore annexed under misgovernance
Revolt of 1857 (First War of Independence); started as Sepoy Mutiny, spread widely but suppressed
Indian National Congress founded by A.O. Hume
Partition of Bengal (by Lord Curzon and launch of Swadeshi and Boycott Movement.
INC session 1905 at Banaras (or Varanasi) presided by Gokhale
All India Muslim League formed Dhaka
Surat Split, when INC splited into Moderstaes and Extrmisns
Gandhi returns to India from South Africa
Rowlatt Act passed
Jallianwala Bagh massacre in Amritsar by Dyer
INC Session at Amritsar presided by Motilal Nehru
Non-Cooperation Movement started by Gandhi.
Chauri Chaura incident and Gandhi suspended Non-Cooperation
Formation of Swaraj Party by CR Das and Motilal Nehru
INC Session of 1924 at Belgaum, only session presided by Gandhi
Simon Commission boycotted ("Go Back Simon")
**Lahore Session of Congress**; demand for Purna Swaraj (Complete Independence)
**Civil Disobedience Movement** started (Dandi Salt March).
**Gandhi-Irwin Pact**; Gandhi attends Second Round Table Conference
The GoI Act 1935 was enacted by the British Parliament
**Quit India Movement** launched by INC and led by Gandhi.
**Cabinet Mission Plan**; proposal for united India with loose federation
**Indian Independence Act**; partition into India and Pakistan; independence on 15 August 1947
**Mountbatten Plan accepted**; led to partition and independence
India became independent (15 August) with Partition happened.
Nov 26 1949 constitution was adopted.
India became a Republic (26 January; Constitution came into force).
[Ramsar convention](((8ReUdEBKH))) was signed on **February 2, 1971**
[Ramsar convention](((8ReUdEBKH))) on Wetlands officially came into force on **December 21, 1975**
India joined the [Ramsar convention](((8ReUdEBKH))) by becoming a party on **February 1, 1982**, designating Chilika Lake and Keoladeo National Park as its first sites
Vienna convention on ozone layer protection
Montreal Protocol on ozone layer protection was adopted.
Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council Act, 1995 and [LAHDC Leh](((ZoOYj9Rzf))) was established
[Kyoto protocol](((KWwYUCgiZ))) on climate change was adopted.
[LAHDC Kargil](((ZoOYj9Rzf))) was established
[Kyoto protocol](((KWwYUCgiZ))) on climate change came into force.
